beats: Kael stands behind the counter, clutching the mysterious letter.
The heavy front door creaks open as the traveller enters from the storm.
The traveller shakes the rain from her heavy cloak in the doorway.
Kael looks up from the letter, his face illuminated by a nearby oil lamp.
The traveller approaches the bar, her eyes calculating and sharp.
The two stand facing each other across the worn wooden counter.
